text.description_html:
4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Stainless Steel Concealed Bearing Hinge, PBB CB514545630

Package includes one (1) complete hinge with matching finish stainless steel flathead, Phillips Drive #12 x 1-1/4" wood screws and 12-24 x 1/2" machine screws.

Medium duty door hinge, standard .134" thickness. Standard full mortise hinge with 3 knuckle design and concealed bearings.

Specifications for the PBB CB514545630 4-1/2" x 4-1/2" Stainless Hinge:

  • Hinge Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Hinge Pin: Stainless Steel, Removable
  • Concealed Bearings
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Rising Removable Pin
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Full Mortise - Conforms to ANSI A5112 for Bearing Hinges
  • Wood Screws: 4 ea. #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: 8 ea. #12-24 x 1/2"

Package with stainless steel machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

Sold Individually (1 door hinge)
